description: Client-side script for 'Maintenance Schedule' form in ERPNext, handling form setup, refresh, related data fetching, and maintenance schedule management including creating maintenance visits.

classes.name: MaintenanceSchedule
classes.description: Controller class extending frappe.ui.form.Controller for Maintenance Schedule, managing schedule-related actions and UI interactions.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, adds custom buttons based on docstatus, and sets dynamic links.

methods.name: start_date
methods.description: Handles start date change, triggers validation of number of visits.

methods.name: end_date
methods.description: Handles end date change, triggers validation of number of visits.

methods.name: periodicity
methods.description: Handles periodicity change, triggers validation of number of visits.

methods.name: set_no_of_visits
methods.description: Validates and sets the number of visits based on start date, end date, and periodicity.
